title: 03687 - B100F/036879
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Airbag Igniter faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Airbag Igniter
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Golf Mk6 platform vehicles using the AirbagVW10G system, the component identifier is:  N298 - Passenger seat belt tensioner igniter 2
This pyrotechnic tensioning device should be sold with the entire three-point automatic seat belt when applicable.   Kontrol edin:  the factory level repair manual and parts catalog for exact details per VIN.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
